dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Folded flight feathers exhibit distinct pale edges with high boundary sharpness against the darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The transition is diffuse and lacks a sharp linear boundary, as the dark scaled crown transitions into a lighter gray hindneck before reaching the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch covering the auricular and lateral neck regions; large, conical, light-colored bill.
